channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Chicagoans Pack Meeting Calling For Probe Into Whether Chicago Cops Helped ICE
item.description: Hundreds showed up to the meeting and dozens raised questions over local police officers' interactions with federal immigration agents, calling to hold police accountable if they have violated sanctuary laws.

item.title: Opioid Task Force Moves Office To West Side Corner That’s ‘Epicenter Of Fentanyl Crisis’
item.description: The West Side Heroin/Opioid Task Force office is based at Lake and Pulaski, what it considers ground zero for the city’s opioid problem. Cook County saw a 41 percent drop in opioid overdose deaths last year.

item.title: A Few Weeks In Photos: Bears To Face Packers Yet Again, Midway Blitz Retrospective And More
item.description: PHOTOS: Take a peek at life in the city through the eyes and lenses of the Block Club Chicago staff.

item.title: More Evidence Ordered Unsealed In Excessive Force Case Against Feds As Dismissal Delayed
item.description: A federal judge ordered the release of about 500 body-cam videos that have not yet been seen by the public.

item.title: Alderman Urged Riders Not To Use Public Transit After Dark, But Data Shows CTA Crime Is Down
item.description: On New Year's Eve, Ald. Jim Gardiner said in a social media post that residents should "avoid" using the CTA "after sundown" until there are safety improvements.

item.title: South Loop Bike Lane Project Paused, Some Lanes Removed As Officials Reassess
item.description: Ald. Pat Dowell said she asked the city to pause the project on 18th Street between Clark and Indiana after some residents raised safety and mobility concerns, and she's working with CDOT to address them.

item.title: Chicago Had Its Rainiest January Day In 50 Years
item.description: Thursday’s storm saw nearly 2 inches of rainfall in just a few hours, flooding streets and canceling the Bulls game at the United Center.

item.title: Police Release New Image Of Missing Bronzeville Teacher As Search Continues Into Weekend
item.description: Linda Brown has been missing since Jan. 3. A new surveillance image provided Friday by police shows her walking alone in the area of 3500 S. Lake Park Ave.

item.title: Bears Beat Packers In Dramatic Playoff Comeback As Storybook Season Continues
item.description: The third Bears-Packers game of the season was just as dramatic as the first two as the Bears mounted another improbable comeback. The Bears will face the Rams at Soldier Field next weekend.

item.title: Lincoln Park Surgeon Charged With Killing His Ex-Wife, Her Husband In Ohio, Authorities Say
item.description: Michael David McKee, a vascular surgeon, was arrested in Rockford Saturday in connection to the killing of husband-and-wife Monique and Spencer Tepe in their Columbus, Ohio, home.
